scripts.build:all: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do (cd "$d" && bun run build) || exit 1; done
scripts.license:sync: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do cp LICENSE "$d/LICENSE"; done
scripts.license:check: for d in packages/*/* apps/*; do cmp -s LICENSE "$d/LICENSE" || { echo "LICENSE out of sync in $d (fix: bun run license:sync)"; exit 1; }; done
scripts.check:code: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run test
scripts.check: bun run check:code && bun run license:check && bun run fallow:check
